name: Release v1.26.0
body:
## Binaries

[https://github.com/jreleaser/jreleaser/wiki/Release-v1.26.0](https://github.com/jreleaser/jreleaser/wiki/Release-v1.26.0)

## Changelog

## 🚀 Features
**packagers**
- 1788008 Option to skip tagging packager repository (opt-out), closes #2162
- 8407e63 Deprecate snap.runOn in favor of smap.buildFor, closes #2159
- bdc08ea Support snap.platforms, closes #2159
- 6602c86 Additional properties in snapcraft templates, closes #2160
- 5689378 improve warnings for incompatible distribution types, closes #2124

## 🐛 Fixes
**assemble**
- c76f76a Fix generated native-image executable name, closes #2146 #2147

**deploy**
- ded0f1c Add missing error message for failed GitLab package deletion, closes #2155
- 1b83dca Make the mavenCentral deployer resilient to transient Central Portal failures, closes #2152

**gradle**
- 633a041 Remove usage of project in favor of AnsiConsole, closes #771
- f8f8ab7 Avoid eager resolve of JReleaserLogger, closes #2145
- c3d1c0f Skip Kordamp plugins if running Gradle +9.7.0, closes #2161

## 🛠  Build

- 9edadad Update GH actions
- c04999a Update snap configuration
- 98de563 Update PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
- 251f5fc Fix update-website script

## 📝 Documentation

- 8e18de4 Add exoego as a contributor for code

## ⚙️  Dependencies

- 4827788 Update aws-java-sdk to 2.54.6
- 3eb5014 Update bouncycastle to 1.85
- 8a5781d Update byte-buddy to 1.18.12
- 49e3dd1 Update classworlds to 2.12.1
- 53ca0d0 Update commons-codec to 1.22.1
- 94834e9 Update commons-jexl to 3.7.0
- b18ba0b Update cosign to 3.1.3
- be9317c Update cyclonedx to 0.33.1
- 701ead6 Update feign to 13.14
- b697379 Update jsoup to 1.23.1
- 6c4535f Update junit5 to 6.1.3
- 8d196db Update syft to 1.51.1
- 73555e1 Update woodstox to 7.2.2
- 890bf01 Update zstd-jni to 1.5.7-15

---
